words.example: I don't have the bandwidth for another project this week.
words.exampleZh: 我这周没有精力再接一个项目。

words.example: The front desk has no capacity to cover phones and the queue together.
words.exampleZh: 前台没有同时接电话又维持排队的承载能力。

words.example: The allocation gives two clerks to clinic and one to the wards.
words.exampleZh: 这次资源分配是门诊两名文员、病区一名。

words.example: My estimate is three days to rewrite the visitor procedure.
words.exampleZh: 我的估算是，重写访客流程要三天。

words.meaning: 关键绩效指标（Key Performance Indicator）
words.example: On-time discharge is the KPI (Key Performance Indicator) for the bed meeting.
words.exampleZh: 准时出院是床位会的 KPI（关键绩效指标）。

words.example: Turn on disk encryption before this laptop leaves the building.
words.exampleZh: 这台笔记本离开大楼前请打开磁盘加密。

words.example: BitLocker is waiting for the recovery key on this clinic laptop.
words.exampleZh: 这台门诊笔记本上的磁盘加密工具正在等恢复密钥。

words.example: USB control stopped a nurse from copying files onto a flash drive.
words.exampleZh: U盘管控拦住了护士往闪存盘拷文件。

words.example: DLP (Data Loss Prevention) blocked the file from leaving the hospital network.
words.exampleZh: DLP（数据防泄漏）拦住了这份要传出医院网络的文件。

words.example: Printer mapping sends ward four jobs to the clinic printer downstairs.
words.exampleZh: 打印机映射把四病区的任务送到了楼下的门诊打印机。
